subject: design-technology
title: Logos & Branding
welcome_lead: What makes a logo work — and a brand stick.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: logos, brands, identity, simplicity.
final_note: A great logo is simple, memorable and unique.

concepts.def: Symbol or wordmark for a brand.
Identity people associate with a company.
Logo made from a simple picture.

walkthroughs.body_html: A wordmark uses just letters (Google, Coca-Cola). A pictogram uses a symbol (Apple, Twitter bird). A monogram uses initials (LV, NY Yankees).
A good logo is simple, memorable, scaleable (works tiny on a phone and huge on a billboard) and relevant to the brand.
Logo is just one part of brand identity — also colours, fonts, photography style and tone of voice. McDonald's red and yellow, Cadbury purple — colour is part of the brand.

mcqs.q: A logo must scale because it goes.
